purpose: Persist decision-relevant observations from substantive investment conversations without converting ordinary discussion into investment-state mutations.

classifications.NO_WRITEBACK: Casual market discussion, exploratory hypothesis, emotional reaction or unverified opinion; no persistence.
classifications.OBSERVATION_WRITEBACK: Evidence-backed decision-preparation finding with a future trigger, review condition or next research action; may be persisted automatically in the observation domain during an active governed ChatGPT interaction.
classifications.STATE_UPDATE_PROPOSAL: User-confirmed transaction, holding, cash, valuation or other state fact that would change an investment-state domain; must follow the existing state writeback gate.
classifications.POLICY_PROPOSAL: Repeated multi-case evidence suggesting a tunable policy change; proposal only until regression/evidence review and explicit user approval.
classifications.CORE_PROPOSAL: Long-lived objective, philosophy or safety-boundary change; proposal only and never automatically applied.
